title: dispatch.rs check_credentials dead code uses plain string equality
description: reader/src/session/dispatch.rs: check_credentials() performs u.password == password (plain string equality, not constant-time). This function is never called in production — the AUTHINFO PASS path in lifecycle.rs goes directly to CredentialStore::check() which correctly uses bcrypt. But the function exists and someone will read it, assume it represents the auth model, and not realize the bcrypt path is the real one. Fix: delete check_credentials() entirely. If needed as a dev-mode stub, add a comment explaining that it is never called in production.
